parsed.rationale: Three production types in the same package `PlayerHeaderView` — `RMSProcessor.reset` (line 55), `FFTProcessor.reset` (line 183), and `AverageProcessor.reset` (line 54) — are flagged as exact function duplicates with no restraint markers (all `is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are false). The naming pattern `*Processor` strongly suggests a shared protocol or base abstraction already exists or should exist. Introducing a `AudioProcessor` protocol (or extending an existing one) with a default `reset()` implementation in a new file `AudioProcessor.swift` within the same package eliminates the triplication and makes the contract explicit. Each conforming type can then delete its own `reset()` body unless it needs to override the default.
